name: Compute Cluster S81: Table Formatting Standards
description: Tests: CardRenderType formatting standards — 11 types with asset-class conventions.
source:
src = study_assets()()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)
vol = volatility(close, period=21)
z = zscore(close, period=60)

summary_table(
    title='Professional Formatting Standards',
    category='Formatting',
    columns=TableSchema(columns=[
        ColumnSpec(name='Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(name='Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(name='Vol (ann)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(name='Z-Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(name='Vol (bps)', type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat, dp=0)
    ])
)(close, ret, vol, z, vol)
